notes.title: Bug Fix 2022-02-16
notes.content: Fixed an issue where achievements weren't working properly. (Applies to Steam Edition's Thai version only)

notes.title: Thai language support!
notes.content:
ALONE now officially supports Thai language.

We'd like to express our sincere appreciation to player [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/c/SytimeZz]SytimeZz[/url][/b], for providing us a Thai translation AND a nice touch on the title screen logo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39902873/13a748edea5057e618a61419a3dbb96bf43008b4.png[/img]
[i]Looks nice![/i]


We hope that players in Thailand will also enjoy the game.

Thanks a lot!
